issues.description: README ASR config link path is broken (conf/train/... vs conf/...).
issues.detail: README links the ASR config as ./conf/train/train_asr_branchformer_e24_amp.yaml, but the file actually lives at ./conf/train_asr_branchformer_e24_amp.yaml. The link 404s on GitHub and the README is wrong about the very thing it documents. Fix the path.

issues.description: download_and_untar.sh warns about missing unzip but does not exit, then calls unzip anyway.
issues.detail: The `command -v unzip` check prints a message and falls through. If unzip is missing, every extraction step fails noisily mid-run instead of aborting cleanly at the boundary. Add `exit 1` after the warning so the script fails fast.

issues.description: Usage block prints then falls through without exit on wrong argc.
issues.detail: When $# is out of range, the script cats usage but does not exit. Execution continues into `realpath $1` with possibly unset positional args, producing a confusing error under set -u instead of a clean usage failure. Add `exit 1` after the usage block.

issues.description: Unquoted command substitutions under set -euo pipefail will break on paths with spaces.
issues.detail: `realpath $1` and `realpath ${2:-$extract_dir}` are unquoted; paths with spaces explode. The rest of the script is careful with set -euo pipefail, so these lines should match. Quote them: `realpath "$1"`.

issues.description: download_and_untar.sh violates its name's contract and three near-identical extraction blocks duplicate logic.
issues.detail: Script never downloads despite its name, breaking the recipe-family contract. Additionally, TAL_ASR-1/2/3 each get a copy-pasted 9-line block differing only in zip name and label. Either honor the download contract or rename to extract.sh, and collapse the three blocks into a table-driven loop to remove drift risk.

issues.description: local/data.sh accepts --downloads_dir but never forwards it to download_and_untar.sh.
issues.detail: The script declares `downloads_dir=` via parse_options.sh, but calls `download_and_untar.sh "${TAL_ZH_ADULT_TEACH}" "${downloads_dir}"` with an unset/empty value. The advertised option silently does nothing useful. Either wire the argument through or remove the option.

synthesis.summary: The panel reaches NEEDS-WORK consensus. The recipe is a standard ESPnet bootcamp contribution, mostly conforming boilerplate and TEMPLATE symlinks. The substantive issues cluster in two files: download_and_untar.sh has multiple fail-soft branches that should fail hard under set -euo pipefail (missing unzip check, usage fallthrough, unquoted command substitutions), plus copy-pasted extraction blocks and a misleading name. The README links the ASR config at a path that does not exist. Smaller contract gaps remain in data.sh argument forwarding. Fixes are small and obvious.
